title: Reading: A Family Day
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 Exam Practice 2 (Ms. Clara), Reading Part 3 (with model answers)

scenes.t: On Sunday, my mom and dad said, 'Let's visit grandpa and grandma.' I was happy. My sister and brother were too.
We all love our grandparents' house. It is big and has a garden. My uncle, aunt, and cousins were there too.
I played football with my brother and cousins. My sister talked with grandma and learned to knit.
Aunt made a big cake for all of us. It was so tasty. We all ate the cake together.
My dad helped grandpa in the garden. Mom talked with my aunt. The parents sat and talked about work and holidays.
The day ended with a big family photo. We all hugged and said goodbye. I can't wait for the next family gathering!

items.q: What activity did the sister learn from grandma?

o: Aunt made a big cake for all of us

items.q: Who did dad help on Sunday?
Where did the family take the photo?
What did grandfather love at the end of the day?
o: Seeing his son and daughters with their families
